name: Beast Titan
tactics: A beast titan opens with titan’s embrace to grab an enemy, then follows up with head rip to savage the captured foe. As does its lesser kin, it turns a powerful attack that hits it against an enemy.

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Beast Reflexes
traits.details: The titan can make a saving throw to avoid falling prone.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature grabbed by the titan

hit.description: damage, and ongoing 10 damage (save ends). The titan also pushes the target 10 squares and knocks it prone.

powers.name: Psionic Release
powers.usageDetails: when the titan uses psionic retention
powers.requirements: The titan must have an attack retained with psionic retention.

hit.description: The target takes the damage and any effects of the retained attack.

powers.name: Titan's Embrace
powers.requirements: The titan must not have a creature grabbed.

hit.description: damage, and the titan grabs the target.

powers.name: Psionic Retention
powers.usageDetails: when an enemy within 5 squares of the titan spends a healing surge
powers.trigger: An enemy damages the giant with an at-will or an encounter attack power.

effect.description: The triggering attack is retained until the end of the titan’s next turn. A retained attack duplicates the triggering attack’s damage and any harmful effects as though originating from the triggering enemy, but not its range or targets. The titan can inflict the same damage and effects of the retained attack on an enemy it hits with psionic release.

powers.name: Vengeful Bite
powers.trigger: The titan is first bloodied or it drops to 0 hit points.
